Ecosystem Control room Workspace Domain Knowledge Frequently Asked Questions Request demo How long does it take to implement? Most firms are live in weeks, not months. Implementation typically starts with connecting key systems and activating Ravical in the inbox, then expands from there. There is no long integration project or system replacement required. Is our data safe and confidential? Yes. Your data remains your data. Ravical is built for regulated accounting and tax environments, with secure, permissioned access and clear auditability. Client information is never used to train public models. How do we stay in control of outputs and client communication? Ravical prepares opportunities and drafts communication, but advisors remain in control. All outputs follow firm defined rules for tone, standards, and escalation, and nothing is sent to clients without the level of human review you choose. How much does it cost? Ravical is priced based on the value it creates for the firm. Pricing is aligned to outcomes such as advisory opportunities identified, services delivered, and overall commercial impact. Which software does Ravical connect with? Ravical connects to the systems accounting and tax firms already use, including email, practice management, CRM, document management, and core accounting and tax platforms. It sits above your existing stack and works across systems rather than replacing them.
